definitions.explanation: Leaves that have fallen from trees, especially in autumn.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}の{道|みち}が{落葉|おちば}で{覆|おお}われている。
examples.english: The park path is covered with fallen leaves.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{落葉|おちば}を{踏|ふ}みながら{楽|たの}しそうに{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: The children are walking happily, crunching through the fallen leaves.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{落|お}ちる (to fall) + {葉|は} (leaf) = fallen leaf/leaves

KANJI NOTE:
Also written as {落|お}ち{葉|ば}. Note the rendaku: は → ば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落葉|おちば}を{掃|は}く: to sweep up fallen leaves
- {落葉|おちば}を{集|あつ}める: to gather fallen leaves
- {落葉|おちば}が{舞|ま}う: fallen leaves flutter/dance
- {落葉|おちば}{拾|ひろ}い: picking up fallen leaves

NOTE:
{落葉|おちば} is a seasonal word associated with autumn. Do not confuse with {落葉|らくよう} (the act of leaves falling; deciduous), which uses the on'yomi reading.
